request.objective: Using reference1 for the museum wall paint and reference2 for the restrained low-polygon visual direction, generate one seamless square albedo texture of only the smooth warm-grey painted plaster visible around the doorway. Even flat diffuse lighting: do not bake sunlight, spotlights, shadows, corners, ceiling, doorway, mouldings, floor, sculpture, labels, grain, stains or cracks into the texture. Tiny restrained broad low-polygon tone changes only, less than three percent contrast; no visible triangular patchwork, polygons outlined as triangles, mottled clouds, marble, stone pattern or beige parchment. The application supplies the existing museum lighting and shaders, so this texture must contain no lighting gradients.
